paras: It is the parties' understanding that the purpose of this exercise is to identify for the Court the names of non-parties that are referenced in the
filings for notice purposes. Paragraph 2 of the Court's October 28, 2019 Order can be read to include all motions
that were decided (both sealed and unsealed) because it references Paragraph 1 of the Order which would mean that the parties would be providing the Court with names that are already in the
domain as they were named in unsealed pacer filings.

Logging all names listed in the already public filings would be a substantial undertaking. Accordingly, the parties wish to confirm with the Court whether the Court wants a list of names of individuals referenced in the sealed filings or whether the Court wants a list of
of individuals referenced in both the sealed filings and the unsealed filings.
